name: osc-bridge
description: OSC ↔ MIDI/SysEx bridge for 849 synths and DAWs — a MIDI MCP and OSC MCP.
long_description: osc-bridge is a declarative bridge between OSC and the music world: 849 hardware synthesizers over MIDI/SysEx, plus music software over OSC (Ableton, Bitwig, Reaper, Sonic Pi, SuperCollider, Pure Data, TouchDesigner, VCV Rack). Its MCP server exposes the whole catalogue to an LLM — list devices, read a device's named OSC surface, send OSC to synths and DAWs, and check a running bridge's status. Both a MIDI MCP (hardware over MIDI/SysEx) and an OSC MCP (DAWs and live-coding environments).

default_target.title: Default OSC target
default_target.description: host:port that the send / get_status tools use when no target argument is given. Defaults to 127.0.0.1:7777 — the standard `osc-bridge run` bind.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Enumerate every device driver — name, vendor, slug, kind (hardware/software), and source tier. Use this first to discover the catalogue.

tools.name: get_device_docs
tools.description: Fetch the markdown companion guide for one device, by slug (the device's OSC prefix without the leading slash, e.g. 'ableton').

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Return the OSC routes a device exposes: declarative commands, CC/NRPN params, SysEx params, and reply patterns.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a single OSC message (typed args: int, float, string, bool) to a running osc-bridge instance — drive synths and DAWs.

args.description: Typed OSC args (int / float / string / bool)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Send /bridge/status to a running osc-bridge and report the replies received within 500 ms.

target.description: host:port to query, defaults to the configured default target
